detail_observations.label: What they say
detail_observations.text: Quest Offering You say, "Hail, Preceptor Indradi." Preceptor Indradi evaluates you slowly, then says, "I have need of someone who is discreet. Something has been stolen and I need it back, but I can't send an army after it, or it will just disappear forever." "The bow of Sendical Valion, Hero of the Orc Wars, was stolen from this sanctuary. I do not have time to look into this myself, despite the importance. Speak with Adept Aliandoa first, she knows something." Adept Aliandoa "Adept Aliandoa," you say. "I need to speak with you, please." "I am sorry, <yourname>," she says, "I do not have time to speak. I have important studies." "This will not be long," you say. "I need to know what you know about the theft." "Ah, that," she says. "Then it definitely won't be long. I do not know much." "Were you there?" "I was," she says, "in a way. I was doing some research that night in the main hall." "What happened?" you ask. "I heard someone using the Words of Unbinding on the door, though I didn't recognize the voice. When I went to look, they were already gone." "Did you find anything besides them gone?" you ask. "Did they leave footprints? Hair?" "They did leave something behind," she says. Reaching into her robe sleeves, she pulls out a griffon's feather. Taking the feather from her, it looks like it came from a griffon's head. "May I keep this?" you ask. "Certainly. Only the royal family and the dragoons might drop something like that. If I were you, I'd see Lieutenant T'vos." she says ."Now, may I get back to my studies?" "Yes, thank you for your time." Lieutenant T'vos "Lieutentant T'vos," you say, "I need to speak with you. You have, no doubt, heard about the theft." "We have," he says gruffly. "What does that have to do with me? Or the Dragoons?" "I am not accusing you of anything," you say. "But I do have some questions for you. There was a witness to the event." "And what has this witness told you that lead to me?" he says, eyebrow raised. You hand him the griffon's feather. "This was found in the hallway. I came to you first for obvious reasons." "You do not have any reason, nor anything to gain, by stealing the bow of Sendical Valion," you continue. "So someone may be trying to frame the dragoons," he says, nodding. "This does look like a feather off one of our griffons. Same breed, but obviously not as well kept as ours. We keep our griffons on a strict diet that this one isn't on." "Do you know who else in the city would have ready access to a griffon or the feathers of one? A wing feather could fall anywhere, but a crown feather?" "That is a little strange to be lying around," he says. "I can say this though, it is not one of our griffons." T'vos then smiles wickedly. "What do you have in mind?" you ask. "We dragoons have ways of finding the light of truth," he says. "Return to report to your patron. I will have an answer for you soon." "Thank you, Lieutenant," you say. Quest Completion "You return so soon. Do you have any news, or are you here to admit your inability to follow through on instructions?" "Well," Preceptor Indradi says, "I am impressed, somewhat. This is at least some progress. We, however, cannot leave this to be solved by the dragoons. As I said, I need someone with discretion, a trait they sorely lack."

Flight Of The Griffon

Level 4 · Diplomacy · Leth Nurae · Thestra

In the King's Chambers

Objectives

Speak with Adept Aliandoa about what she knows of the theft, then speak with whom she says. Return to Preceptor Indradi when complete. - Speak to Adept Aliandoa - Speak to Lieutenant T'vos

I do not have time to look into this myself, despite the importance. Speak with Adept Aliandoa first, she knows something."
